finding.claim: Remote HTML fetched for an embed is emitted raw, bypassing the html_input setting (escape/strip) that applies to inline and block raw HTML.
finding.source: Attacker-published page at an allowed URL (or any https URL when embed.allowed_domains is empty) whose oEmbed/meta HTML contains script; attacker supplies a standalone https:// line in Markdown.
finding.sink: EmbedRenderer::render returns $node->getEmbedCode() unescaped into the output HTML.

trace.note: Block start accepts a line beginning with https://.
Remote page fetched via Embed library getMulti().
extractor->code->html copied into embed via setEmbedCode().
Stored embed code returned raw; no html_input check or escaping.

finding.guards_checked: https-only start rule (EmbedStartParser:34); DomainFilteringAdapter host allowlist (DomainFilteringAdapter:40-61, applied only when allowed_domains non-empty per EmbedExtension:38-41); EmbedProcessor fallback only when no code produced (EmbedProcessor:59-70). html_input is not consulted on the embed path (contrast HtmlInlineRenderer:44-46, HtmlBlockRenderer:44). Unverified: whether the Embed library escapes the HTML it extracts; vendor source not present.

finding.claim: Embed allowlist checks only the initial URL; the server-side fetch may follow redirects to internal or link-local hosts, and no private-IP filtering exists.
finding.source: Markdown embed URL on an allowed domain (or any domain when allowed_domains is empty) that redirects to e.g. http://169.254.169.254/ or an internal host.
finding.sink: Server-side HTTP request issued by Embed library getMulti() in OscaroteroEmbedAdapter::updateEmbeds.

trace.note: Embeds passed to adapter when top-level.
Filter applied to the original URL before the decorated adapter.
Host compared against allowed domains (equal or subdomain).
getMulti() fetches the URL; redirect handling is in the vendor library.

finding.guards_checked: Host allowlist on the first URL only (DomainFilteringAdapter:54-58); no check of redirect targets or resolved IPs in this repo; no filter at all when embed.allowed_domains is empty (EmbedExtension:39-41); percent-encoding via UrlEncoder runs before validation so no parse_url differential found. Unverified: redirect-following and IP-blocking behaviour of the vendor Embed library, which is not present in this directory. Impact is likely blind SSRF or limited to what the extractor reflects into embed HTML.
